channel.title: ARLing Notes
channel.description: Krátke a presné odpovede na chyby, ktoré vývojári a slovenskí účtovníci stále hľadajú. Každá poznámka končí nástrojom, ktorý to skontroluje.

item.title: AI is now "Super Intelligence" in US federal agencies: what the order requires
item.description: On 29 September 2026 a US executive order told federal agencies to use "Super Intelligence" and "SI" in place of "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI". What the order text requires, what it leaves alone, its one 60-day deadline, and how to change a document without rewriting law titles.

item.title: Dobropis a oprava základu dane: v ktorom období sa opravuje DPH
item.description: Kedy dobropis patrí do obdobia, keď ste ho vyhotovili, a kedy treba dodatočné priznanie za pôvodné obdobie. Zákon o DPH, príklady Finančnej správy, sadzba a náležitosti.

item.title: Faktúra e-mailom v roku 2026: stačí súhlas zaplatením?
item.description: Súhlas s faktúrou e-mailom môže byť aj jej zaplatenie, píše Finančná správa. Kedy je taká faktúra vyhotovená, výnimka roku 2026 a čo sa mení od 1. 1. 2027.

item.title: It does not have HTTP ok status: what the CORS preflight (OPTIONS) request needs
item.description: Why Chrome says the preflight does not have HTTP ok status, which server layer turns your OPTIONS request into a 401, 404, 405 or 500, and how to answer it with a 2xx.

item.title: Redirect is not allowed for a preflight request: CORS, redirects and the trailing slash
item.description: Why Chrome refuses a CORS preflight that gets a 3xx, how to find the redirect with one curl command, and the usual causes: a trailing slash, www, https or a login page.

item.title: Request header field is not allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Headers: fixing the preflight allow-list
item.description: Why the CORS preflight rejects a request header such as Authorization or Content-Type, how to read the full list the browser asked for, and how to fix Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

item.title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*' with credentials mode 'include': why cookies need an exact origin
item.description: Why browsers reject Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on requests with cookies, where the * comes from in Express or Laravel, and the two headers that fix it.

item.title: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: find the two rules redirecting to each other (Cloudflare, nginx, proxies, WordPress)
item.description: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS means two layers keep undoing each other's redirect. Read the loop with curl, then fix the Cloudflare, nginx, proxy or WordPress rule behind it.

item.title: "The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID": Sign In With Google and JavaScript origins
item.description: Google Identity Services logs this when the scheme, host and port of your page match no entry in Authorized JavaScript origins. The causes in order, and the fix for each.

item.title: JWT "invalid signature": wrong secret, wrong key, or the wrong algorithm
item.description: What JsonWebTokenError: invalid signature rules out, the four byte mismatches behind it, and how to prove which one you have before you change any code.

item.title: "jwt malformed": what your verifier received instead of a token
item.description: jsonwebtoken throws jwt malformed when the value does not split into three parts at the periods. What arrived instead of a token, and the fix for each case.

item.title: Set-Cookie blocked because of SameSite=Lax: fixing a session cookie from a cross-site API
item.description: Why Chrome drops a Set-Cookie without SameSite from a cross-site API response, how to tell cross-site from cross-origin, and the two routes that fix it.

item.title: Leitweg-ID fehlt (BR-DE-15): wo sie in die XRechnung gehört
item.description: Leitweg-ID fehlt, Fehler BR-DE-15: Die ID gehört in die Käuferreferenz BT-10 (cbc:BuyerReference). Wo sie herkommt, wie Sie die Datei korrigieren und was der KoSIT-Validator in unserem Test nicht prüfte.
